title: test(cli): authoring-door spawn family — share repeated spawns, declare budgets (#23181 slice 16)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLW4ZjyuLt1yEBySkebVp6y)_

Part of #23181 (slice 16). The card is a series and stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Test-only diff: `skip-changeset`. Eight files under `packages/cli/test/`, which is not in `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`); no `files[]` changes in any package.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:cli 里 8 个「真实调用 `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`」的作者门测试文件。其中 2 个把重复的同一条 CLI 调用合并成 `beforeAll` 里跑一次;8 个都在第 2 行加了 `// test-budget:` 声明。
- 为什么改:这 8 个文件在 CI 上都超过 10 s。逐个数了调用:6 个文件的每次调用都是不同的(命令、参数、夹具)组合,耗时下限就是调用次数,按裁决 6181973363 B 声明预算;2 个对等性文件把同一组合跑了 2–3 次,合并后本地实测各快约 43%。
- 风险与回滚:无运行时风险,只动测试;每条断言原样保留、含义不变,未改超时与分层。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/test/lint-per-package-authoring-parity.test.ts` 的 `beforeAll`、`packages/cli/test/validate-per-package-authoring-parity.test.ts` 的 `beforeAll`(唯二有逻辑改动的地方),其余 6 个文件只有第 2 行。
- 两分钟验证:`cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/lint-per-package-authoring-parity.test.ts test/validate-per-package-authoring-parity.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件 9 个用例全绿,单文件约 14–17 s。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Counted from the code** (spawns = CLI child processes per file run; triples = distinct command, flags and fixture):

| file | CI max (s) | tests | spawns before | distinct triples | change | budget |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|--:|
| `test/stack-conversion-record-door.test.ts` | 141.61 | 22 | 24 | 24 | header | 180 |
| `test/stack-provenance-door.test.ts` | 60.77 | 12 | 12 | 12 | header | 80 |
| `test/picklist-reference-doors.test.ts` | 57.37 | 11 | 11 | 11 | header | 80 |
| `test/lint-per-package-authoring-parity.test.ts` | 43.77 | 5 | 9 | 5 | shared `beforeAll` (9 → 5 spawns) + header | 60 |
| `test/union-fold-command-parity.test.ts` | 33.65 | 9 | 9 | 9 | header | 50 |
| `test/package-union-readers.test.ts` | 32.22 | 7 | 9 | 9 | header | 50 |
| `test/validate-per-package-authoring-parity.test.ts` | 28.80 | 4 | 7 | 4 | shared `beforeAll` (7 → 4 spawns) + header | 40 |
| `test/validate-view-container-name.test.ts` | 20.34 | 5 | 4 | 4 | header | 30 |

No file is under 10 s in any reading, so every file gets a header.

**The two hoists.** In `lint-per-package-authoring-parity` the cases spawned `os build --json` on the flip fixture three times and `os lint --json` on it three times. In `validate-per-package-authoring-parity` the cases spawned `os build --json` on the multi-package fixture three times and `os validate --json` on it twice. Each file now runs each distinct triple once, in sequence, in its existing `beforeAll`, and each case reads the shared run of its triple. Every assertion is unchanged, in the same case, on the output of the same command, flags and fixture. The hook's timeout is the old per-case allowance (180 s) times the spawns it runs, so no per-spawn allowance moved. The spawns stay sequential: no in-file concurrency.

**The header.** One line at line 2 of each file, the ruled grammar `// test-budget: N — spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture: REASON` (ruling record 6181973363, letter B; grammar `readTestBudget` in `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`). N = slowest CI reading x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s. After the hoists every remaining spawn in all eight files is a distinct triple, so the spawn count is the floor.

## Why

**The reading.** No shard-timings refresh has run on `main` since the oclif test manifest (PR #26256). The CI numbers are the vitest module lines (they include `beforeAll`) of the three scheduled full-battery `ci.yml` runs on `main` after it, all with the manifest setup on:

| file | 40392443783 (`69aa630b9f`) | 40424746941 (`e843b5b320`) | 40447801748 (`26e7c75e9a`) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `stack-conversion-record-door` | **141.61** | 98.16 | 97.84 |
| `stack-provenance-door` | **60.77** | 59.62 | 37.58 |
| `picklist-reference-doors` | 43.88 | 56.55 | **57.37** |
| `lint-per-package-authoring-parity` | **43.77** | 42.36 | 26.12 |
| `union-fold-command-parity` | **33.65** | 32.07 | 20.57 |
| `package-union-readers` | 22.68 | 30.03 | **32.22** |
| `validate-per-package-authoring-parity` | **28.80** | 21.83 | 24.89 |
| `validate-view-container-name` | **20.34** | 19.96 | 12.91 |

The first two columns are slice 15's readings (report on #23181). The third run is newer, so it was read too (its Test Core shards via `get_job_logs`: 510 cli file lines; the run's own failure is in `Test UI (1/16)`, not Test Core).

**The two hoisted files keep the pre-hoist budget.** Their budgets come from CI readings of the 9-spawn and 7-spawn shapes, the only CI readings that exist. Locally the hoist cuts them by about 44%. A shard-timings refresh re-sizes the budget from the new shape; it is not lowered by hand.

## Tests

<details><summary>A/B of the two hoisted files (N=3, one lock hold)</summary>

The BASE file (`775a0006bd`) copied next to the HEAD file as `test/zzbase-*.test.ts`, all four in one run, `cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=default`, three runs in one `os-verify-lock` hold on a shared 4-vCPU container, manifest setup on (queue tier). The copies were deleted before the gates ran. Each run: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 18 passed (18)`, exit 0.

| file | BASE (s) | HEAD (s) | change |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `lint-per-package-authoring-parity` | 32.21 / 30.80 / 30.29 | 17.36 / 17.08 / 17.25 | about -44% (9 → 5 spawns) |
| `validate-per-package-authoring-parity` | 25.54 / 23.35 / 24.31 | 13.72 / 13.77 / 14.67 | about -43% (7 → 4 spawns) |

</details>

<details><summary>The family on this head</summary>

Same command, `--maxWorkers=2`, the eight files: `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 75 passed (75)`, exit 0, run wall 155.3 s. Per file (s): stack-conversion-record-door 102.2, stack-provenance-door 41.6, picklist-reference-doors 38.5, union-fold-command-parity 23.8, package-union-readers 20.2, lint-per-package-authoring-parity 18.3, validate-view-container-name 14.1, validate-per-package-authoring-parity 13.9.

</details>

<details><summary>Header parse, before and after</summary>

`readTestBudget` on each file at BASE `775a0006bd` returns `null` for all eight (a file over 10 s with no declared budget, the offender reading). On this head all eight return class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture` at line 2, seconds 180 / 80 / 80 / 60 / 50 / 50 / 40 / 30.

</details>

<details><summary>Typecheck and lint</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the eight files: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Pin: the next shard-timings refresh lists none of these eight files in its over-budget table. Each appears under the budget it declares, and comes back only if a run reads it over its own budget.
- Nothing else repeats a triple in this family. `package-union-readers` already ran its nine distinct spawns in shared `beforeAll` hooks, two at a time; that pre-existing shape is untouched.
- Next unheadered family (out of scope here, per the order): `test/verify-*.test.ts`.

## Verification

Local gates at `35212c7e`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 48 commands. Each ran with its exit code captured by redirect before any pipe: 47 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and exited 0 after `git fetch origin 621a487607`. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist/`, and only the cli dependency closure was built); it is NOT MEASURED locally and runs in CI. `--ran` reconciliation: `48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 47 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, exit 0.

The three artifact-roster families whose roster sits under `packages/` were run too: `pnpm check:authz-resolver`, `pnpm check:error-code-casing` and `pnpm check:filter-alias-parity`, each exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the `test:repo` project are left to CI (Lint & Repo Gates, Test Core).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the eight files locally; the repo-wide run is CI's)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
